bullets.text: Residents in Tiruvallur protested on the road at midnight over continuous power cuts, and the office should monitor power supply restoration.
A sudden road cave-in near Phoenix Mall caused severe traffic disruption in Velachery, and the office should track repair work.
A cyclonic storm is likely to form over the Bay of Bengal, and the Thiruvallur team should monitor weather alerts.
Damaged concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB put the public at risk, and the office should urge the Highways department to act.
Locals in Tiruttani expect a new building as the panchayat office operates in a damaged library, and the office should follow up.
Cisco executive Jeetu Patel supports unlimited AI access for Gen Z to improve software development, and the portfolio team should note this.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman questioned PC RAM use amid global DRAM supply pressure, and the office should watch memory industry trends.
